extracted.intended_audience: students and scholars of political science; general readers interested in public opinion and American regional political culture
extracted.subtask_short: analysis of US public opinion regions
extracted.subtask_description: A scholarly chapter describing how social classes, professions, and regional economies shape public opinion across Eastern, Western, Pacific, and Southern United States; summarizes characteristics, influences, and political behavior of different groups. Useful as background reading on the formation and local varieties of public opinion in the US.
